title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: localised default result email for user reported messages
summary: The rollout dates, licensing, default behaviour and documented controls are supported. The broader assertion that data access is unchanged is not established by the sources and should be removed; the narrower statements about unchanged verdicts, classification and investigation behaviour are documented.
